title: Bare Bones - Pixel Consistent Cave Spiders
description: Remodels the cave spider so it's no longer a scaled down version of the regular spider
body:
This pack remodels the cave spider so that it's no longer a downscaled version of the regular spider. 

This means its pixel scaling is now consistent with the environment, much like how Mojang did with the tiny takeover update.

---

Requires [_Entity Texture Features_](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures), and [_Entity Model Features_](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) (or Optifine).

Click here for the version of this pack supporting [_Fresh Animations_](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations-x-bare-bones-pixel-consistent-cave-spiders). 
\
Note that it is _not_ and addon pack. You will not need this vanilla version if you use the Fresh Animations one.
